license_required.quote: it is unlawful for a person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry ... without first obtaining from the board a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of medical examiners provided for in 2-15-1731.

moral_character_required.quote: is of good moral character as determined by the board

exams.name: National Board of Podiatry Examiners

exams.quote: has passed an examination administered by the national board of podiatry examiners and is a diplomate of the national board of podiatry examiners

definition_quote.value: A podiatrist may diagnose and treat ailments of the human functional foot and ankle by all systems and means. The functional foot is the anatomical foot and any muscle, tendon, ligament, or other soft tissue structure that is directly attached to the anatomical foot and that impacts on or affects the foot or foot function. The ankle is the articulation between the talus, tibia, and fibula and their related soft tissue structures.

drug_authority.value: A licensed podiatrist may administer and prescribe drugs as a medical practitioner
drug_authority.quote: A licensed podiatrist may administer and prescribe drugs in accordance with 37-2-101 as a "medical practitioner".

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The ankle is the articulation between the talus, tibia, and fibula and their related soft tissue structures.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A podiatrist may not administer any anesthetic other than a local anesthetic.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: a podiatrist may not perform surgical treatments of the ankle unless certified to do so by the board

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: The board shall certify a podiatrist whom it considers qualified by education, training, and experience or who is certified by the American board of podiatric surgery.

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: must be performed in a hospital or outpatient center for surgical services licensed under Title 50

board_certification_body.quote: who is certified by the American board of podiatric surgery

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as prohibiting the fitting, recommending, advertising, adjusting, or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports, or similar mechanical appliances, or foot remedies by retail dealers or manufacturers.
